title: Grineer Asteroid Fortress/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Background dialogue spoken throughout the tileset.
- Worm Queen: "Get to work you rotten beasts! You flea-flocking meat sacks! This Kuva is garbage! We need more or you all are going to the meat grinder for tomorrow's meal. (laughs)"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0010WormQueen_en.ogg
- Worm Queen: "My sister is sick, you grey maggots. From now on, work details are doubled. Halved rations until Kuva distillation is meeting production targets!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0020WormQueen_en.ogg
- Worm Queen: "Continuity is fueled by the Kuva. It's so very crucial - oh, why do I bother? Whippings will be increased until further notice!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0030WormQueen_en.ogg
- Worm Queen: "We need more of the red stuff! If I could bleed it out of you, I would. Get to work meat sacks before I purge this entire work detail into space!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0040WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "I like to cook. Are you surprised? I'm working on a few new recipes - appetizers mainly. Soups and the like. And you uglies are going to be the broth if you don't make enough Kuva for us!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0050WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "My dopey little doompa groompas. (laughs) I love watching you work. Remember maggots, Kuva is a fuel of Continuity so we have to keep working! You don't want to see me unhappy do you? (maniacal laughter)"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0060WormQueen_en.ogg
- Worm Queen: "Ahem, let's see, a few announcements. All dogs found taking more than their allotted breaks will be integrated into this evening's protein slurry, hah!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0070WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "Attention, there are only three valid reasons to cease working on the Kuva supply: one, a Dreamer has arrived with a hideous metal puppet—you may pause your work to kill it; two, you have died from exhaustion, please remain dead until your body has been collected by food services; three, uh, three, hmm, I guess that only makes two reasons hahaha!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0080WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "Pardon the interruption. Due to difficult work conditions, we've added a suggestion box to the distillery. To recieve a suggestion on how to serve me better, simply open the box and stare directly into the plasma emitter. Workplace enlightenment will be yours! (laughs) That is all, maggots!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0090WormQueen_en.ogg
- Worm Queen: "Recently, poor working conditions have been brought to my attention. I completely agree with you mangy meatbags. Your work is very poor. Step it up or you will be stepping into space!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0100WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "The abysmal Kuva production was puzzling me until I realized... maybe it's the lack of positive reinforcement? No problem maggots! We've reversed the battery packs in our reinforcement prods, effective immediately! (maniacal laughter)"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0110WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "It's the simple things in life I've come to cherish. A high protein meal, a shimmering vial of Kuva, a Warframe bursting like a pustule as it's shot into space. Oh yum! Who's hungry? (laughs)"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0120WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "Hmm? Let's see these new Kuva production charts (laughter). Oh, I see. Ahem, on a completely unrelated note, all ship supervisors are to report immediately to food services. Time to see how you ration the meat from the inside."
DWormQueenAnnouncements0130WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "Pardon the interruption, but unfortunately we are declaring several (chuckles) redundancies today, across all departments. Say goodbye to: scheduled breaks, compensation, and regular meals. We wish them all the best in their future endeavors. (maniacal laughter)"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0140WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "'I'm doing a great job. I am a valued member of this functional and productive Kuva team.' Does this describe you? If so, I'd love to have some (laughs) face time with you! I'd love to have some (laughs) face time with you. Just pull out the synergy pin of your service collar and count to four!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0150WormQueen_en.ogg
- Worm Queen: "You. Lazy. Leeches! If I don't see drastic improvements in your work output, I'll be forced to do some restructuring! (laughs) How would you like a spine for eyes?"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0160WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "Curious worker K97 writes: 'Your majesty, what are some delicious ways to make protein slurry?' Oh well, I'm so glad you took the time out of your work detail to ask this! You've inspired a whole new line of meat pies (laughs). Mmm, mmm, gamey!"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0170WormQueen_en.ogg

- Worm Queen: "Okay, you bottom feeding gravel-heels, listen up. I'm introducing a new incentive program. Those Grineer turning in Warframe carcasses will be generously compensated. Those failing to do so will be (laughs) generously disemboweled. Got it!?"
DWormQueenAnnouncements0180WormQueen_en.ogg
